name: No More Little Match Girl
source:
What if I told you that the Little Match Girl didn't have to die at the end of that fairy tale? I mean, she can, if you really want her to... but hasn't she been through enough?

Take control of a classic tale and let it play out the way you want it to. Maybe you freeze to death, maybe you take a rich brat down with you, or maybe you get hit by a carriage before you even have time to think. The choice is yours...

[From [url=https://marmorhaus.itch.io/no-more-little-match-girl]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
如果我告诉你卖火柴的小女孩不必在童话故事的结尾死去呢？我的意思是，如果你真的希望她这么做，她可以……但她经历的还不够多吗？

掌控一个经典故事，让它按照你想要的方式发展。也许你冻死了，也许你带走了一个富家子弟，或者也许你还没来得及思考就被马车撞了。选择权是你的…

[来自[url=https://marmorhaus.itch.io/no-more-little-match-girl]itch.io[/url]]
